annotations.title: ABC / Pareto inventory analysis with optional XYZ demand variability

description: ABC / Pareto inventory analysis with optional XYZ demand variability — Offline ABC classification of products, SKUs, customers or suppliers by value. items= (required) name:annual_value;... or name:units:unit_cost;... (3-5000 items). Optional a=80 and b=95 cumulative % cut-offs; history=name:d1,d2,d3;... per-period demand enables XYZ classes by coefficient of variation (x=0.5, y=1.0 thresholds) and the ABC-XYZ matrix with replenishment guidance. Returns class summary (items %, value %), Pareto share of the top 20% of items, Gini coefficient with concentration label, control policy per class and the ranked list with share and cumulative % (limit=, default 200). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_abc_analysis
